"""Compute Trigger F1, Argument F1, Entity F1 for WikiEvents dry run."""
import json
from collections import defaultdict

def compute_f1(tp, fp, fn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
    r = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
    f1 = 2*p*r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0
    return p, r, f1

def evaluate_file(path, label):
    total_trigger_tp = total_trigger_fp = total_trigger_fn = 0
    total_arg_tp = total_arg_fp = total_arg_fn = 0
    total_ent_tp = total_ent_fp = total_ent_fn = 0
    
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            rec = json.loads(line)
            parsed = rec.get("parsed_output")
            gold_events = rec.get("gold_events", [])
            gold_entities = rec.get("gold_entities", [])
            
            if parsed is None:
                total_trigger_fn += len(gold_events)
                for ge in gold_events:
                    total_arg_fn += len(ge.get("arguments", []))
                total_ent_fn += len(gold_entities)
                continue
            
            pred_events = parsed.get("events", [])
            pred_entities = parsed.get("entities", [])
            
            # Trigger F1: (trigger_text, event_type) match
            gold_triggers = set()
            for ge in gold_events:
                gold_triggers.add((ge["trigger"].lower(), ge["event_type"]))
            
            pred_triggers = set()
            for pe in pred_events:
                pred_triggers.add((pe["trigger"].lower(), pe["event_type"]))
            
            trigger_tp = len(gold_triggers & pred_triggers)
            total_trigger_tp += trigger_tp
            total_trigger_fp += len(pred_triggers) - trigger_tp
            total_trigger_fn += len(gold_triggers) - trigger_tp
            
            # Argument F1: (trigger_text, event_type, arg_role, arg_text) match
            gold_args = set()
            for ge in gold_events:
                for arg in ge.get("arguments", []):
                    gold_args.add((ge["trigger"].lower(), ge["event_type"], arg["role"], arg["text"].lower()))
            
            pred_args = set()
            for pe in pred_events:
                for arg in pe.get("arguments", []):
                    pred_args.add((pe["trigger"].lower(), pe["event_type"], arg["role"], arg["text"].lower()))
            
            arg_tp = len(gold_args & pred_args)
            total_arg_tp += arg_tp
            total_arg_fp += len(pred_args) - arg_tp
            total_arg_fn += len(gold_args) - arg_tp
            
            # Entity F1: (text, type) match
            gold_ent_set = set((e["text"].lower(), e["type"]) for e in gold_entities)
            pred_ent_set = set((e["text"].lower(), e["type"]) for e in pred_entities)
            
            ent_tp = len(gold_ent_set & pred_ent_set)
            total_ent_tp += ent_tp
            total_ent_fp += len(pred_ent_set) - ent_tp
            total_ent_fn += len(gold_ent_set) - ent_tp
    
    tp, rp, tf1 = compute_f1(total_trigger_tp, total_trigger_fp, total_trigger_fn)
    ap, ar, af1 = compute_f1(total_arg_tp, total_arg_fp, total_arg_fn)
    ep, er, ef1 = compute_f1(total_ent_tp, total_ent_fp, total_ent_fn)
    
    print(f"=== {label} ===")
    print(f"  Trigger F1: P={tp:.3f} R={rp:.3f} F1={tf1:.3f}")
    print(f"  Argument F1: P={ap:.3f} R={ar:.3f} F1={af1:.3f}")
    print(f"  Entity F1: P={ep:.3f} R={er:.3f} F1={ef1:.3f}")
    print()

evaluate_file("/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/outputs/wikievents_unconstrained.jsonl", "UNCONSTRAINED")
evaluate_file("/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/outputs/wikievents_full_s1.jsonl", "CONSTRAINED (full_s1)")
EOF
